en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate parliamentary chamber with wooden desks and high‑backed chairs arranged in rows. The room features rich wall paneling, large paintings or reliefs, tall columns, and grand crystal chandeliers hanging from a coffered ceiling. Along the right margin there is handwritten cursive text. Printed caption text in Finnish appears below the image, along with a small printer's mark and number.
